stem: Which one of the following towns is nearest to the Tropic of Cancer :
expl: The place whose latitudinal position is at a minimum distance from the latitude of the Tropic of Cancer will be the nearest place to the Tropic of Cancer. The Tropic of Cancer is at 23° 30' N; divides India into almost two equal parts. Latitudinal position of the towns given in the options is :- Place Latitude Difference in Position Agartala 23º 50' N –20' Gandhinagar 23º19' N +11' Jabalpur 23º 11' N +19' Ujjain 23º 09' N +21' According to the distance from the Tropic of Cancer, Gandhinagar is the nearest town . Thus, option (b) is the correct answer.

stem:
Which of the following statements are true?
I. The Tropic of Cancer divides India into two halves.
II. The Tropic of Cancer divides Indian International boundary into two halves.
III. Maximum East-West expansion of India lies along the Tropic of Cancer.
IV. Line joining the easternmost and westernmost points of India lies to the north of the Tropic of Cancer.
Select the correct answer from the options given below:
expl: The Tropic of Cancer is an imaginary line (23030' North latitude passes through the middle of the country). This imaginary line divides India into two halves. Significantly, the Tropic of Cancer does not divide the Indian International boundary into two halves. Notably, the maximum east-west expansion of India does not lie along the Tropic of Cancer. Significantly the line joining the easternmost and westernmost points of India lies to the north of the Tropic of Cancer. Easternmost point of India is Kibithu in Arunachal Pradesh while the Westernmost point is Guhar Moti in the Kutch district of Gujarat.

stem: Which, among the following places, will have maximum day length in the month of June ?
expl: The length of days in northern hemisphere, starts increasing after the sun moves north of equator. On 21 June (summer solstice), the sun is directly overhead, and the north pole is tilted towards the sun; and therefore, the northern hemisphere has days ranging from just over 12 hours around to 24 hours in Arctic Circle. Delhi is the most appropriate answer as it is the most northerly given option.

stem: Which of the following rivers of India crosses the Tropic of Cancer twice?
